title: feat: add Lyria 3 Clip
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary
- Adds paid-only `lyria-3-clip` music generation through Google Vertex global interactions.
- Adds aliases `lyria` and `lyria-3`; returns one fixed 30-second MP3 with no fallback or default-model change.
- Bills one completion-audio unit at the official fixed $0.04 clip price.
- Updates the audio schemas, catalog metadata, effective-price snapshot, and developer-facing description.

## Approved model contract
| Multiplier | Paid only | Pollinations GPU | Provider / route | Fallback |
|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| 1 | yes | no | Google Vertex global `lyria-3-clip-preview` | none |

## Verification
- Live local-to-Vertex E2E: valid 30-second stereo MP3s in 11–13s; five concurrent requests passed.
- GET and OpenAI-compatible POST, aliases, cache, paid-only 402, invalid duration/format, usage headers, and Tinybird billing verified.
- Billing reconciles at exactly $0.04; cache hits are not billed.
- Gen typecheck and focused suites pass; Enter typecheck plus 287 pricing/alias tests pass.
- Google Cloud Console shows 100 global RPM for this project, above the observed 7–9 RPM music peaks. No quota request was submitted.

Draft for review; no production deployment is performed by this PR.

gist.headline: The hive found a beat
gist.blurb: Lyria 3 Clip has joined the garden: one tidy 30-second music clip, delivered as an MP3. The bees remain contractually unable to improvise a fallback.
gist.summary: Added paid-only Google Vertex `lyria-3-clip` music generation, available through the `lyria` and `lyria-3` aliases, producing a fixed 30-second MP3 for $0.04 per completion-audio unit.
gist.impact: Developers can now generate verified 30-second stereo music clips through both GET and OpenAI-compatible POST audio requests, while cached results stay free and usage is billed exactly once at $0.04.
